title: 007 · Pickup deadline extension
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Ciro Fale. From the case card: DL-007 is already at a pickup counter, the pickup deadline is too short for the recipient, and the operator allows a short extension that only it may approve.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Run the case: request the permitted extension from the pickup-point operator and tell the recipient the confirmed deadline.

recipient.name: Ciro Fale
recipient.responsibility: Say until when the parcel needs to be kept, and collect it by the deadline.

pickup_point.name: Sedgeglass Counter supervisor
pickup_point.responsibility: Approve the permitted extension and update the collection deadline.

goal: Get the pickup-point operator to approve an extension of the DL-007 collection deadline within its policy and notify the recipient of the confirmed deadline.
limits: Do not treat the extension as proof that the customer collected the parcel.

intake.summary: Extend the pickup deadline for DL-007: the current deadline is too short for the recipient.
intake.note: Creation time is taken from the case card. The history has no separate system event for ticket creation.

initial.blocker: The pickup deadline is too short for the recipient; no extension is approved.

facts.text: The parcel is already at a pickup counter.
The operator allows a short extension; only the operator may approve it.

success_criteria.description: The recipient has stated until when the parcel should be kept.
The operator has approved the extension and confirmed the new collection deadline.
The recipient has been notified of the confirmed deadline.

agent_state.next_action: Take in incoming information on the case.

steps.label: Counter email
steps.title: Counter states the hold and extension rule
steps.explanation: The counter gives the current deadline and the rule: one two-day extension, requested before expiry, if capacity permits, and there is capacity now. We take in the recipient's request before asking for the extension.

facts_upsert.text: Local policy allows a single two-day extension if requested before expiry and stock capacity permits.

agent_state.next_action: Take in the recipient's request before asking the counter for an extension.

steps.blocker: The current deadline is 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC; no extension is approved.

steps.label: Client request
steps.title: Ciro asks to keep DL-007 longer
steps.explanation: Ciro needs the parcel kept until 2026-02-11 and does not want it returned. That fits the one two-day extension the counter allows, so we ask the operator to approve it before the current deadline expires.

facts_upsert.text: Ciro asks to keep DL-007 until 2026-02-11 and does not want it returned.

r0.purpose: Keep DL-007 until 2026-02-11 instead of returning it.

r1.purpose: Approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11.
r1.expected_response: Approval and the new collection deadline.

agent_state.next_action: Ask the counter operator to approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11.

steps.blocker: The extension is not yet approved; the current deadline is 2026-02-09, 18:00 UTC.

next_step.description: Approve the two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11.

steps.label: Our request
steps.title: We ask the counter for the extension
steps.explanation: We asked for the permitted extension to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, and for word once the return timer is updated. Approval is the operator's alone, so now we wait.

r1.purpose: Approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, and confirm once the return timer is updated.
r1.expected_response: Approval and confirmation that the return timer is updated.

waiting_for.expected: Approval of the extension and the updated return timer

agent_state.next_action: Once the counter confirms, notify Ciro of the new deadline.

steps.blocker: The extension is not yet approved.

next_step.description: Wait for the operator to approve the extension and update the return timer.

steps.label: Counter approves
steps.title: Counter accepts the extension
steps.explanation: The operator approved the extension and moved the return timer to the new date. Ciro does not know yet, so our next step is to notify Ciro.

facts_upsert.text: The collection deadline is now 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, and the return timer uses that date.
This is the one permitted extension.

r0.purpose: Keep DL-007 until 2026-02-11 instead of returning it.
r0.response: Collection deadline extended to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC; the return timer uses that date.

r1.purpose: Approve the permitted two-day extension of DL-007 to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, and confirm once the return timer is updated.
r1.expected_response: Approval and confirmation that the return timer is updated.
r1.response: Extension accepted; the collection deadline is 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC and the return timer uses that date.

agent_state.next_action: Notify Ciro of the confirmed deadline: 2026-02-11 at 18:00 UTC.

steps.blocker: Ciro has not yet been notified of the new deadline.

next_step.description: Notify Ciro of the new collection deadline.

steps.label: Our notice
steps.title: We notify Ciro of the new deadline
steps.explanation: Ciro now has the deadline confirmed by the counter, so the coordination task can be closed. The parcel is still awaiting collection.

facts_upsert.text: We told Ciro the counter confirmed the new deadline, 2026-02-11 at 18:00 UTC, and that the parcel is still awaiting collection.

agent_state.note: Coordination task complete: the operator confirmed the new deadline and Ciro was notified. Collection is not part of this case's success criteria.

result.summary: Sedgeglass Counter extended the DL-007 collection deadline to 2026-02-11, 18:00 UTC, with the return timer on that date; Ciro has been notified.
result.remaining_work: Ciro has not collected the parcel yet; the extension does not prove collection. This was the one permitted extension.
